annotations.title: Check digits of UFI, CAS, EC and GTIN

description: Use this when someone wants to know whether a UFI, CAS number, EC number or GTIN/EAN is well formed: "Is CAS 64-17-5 valid?", "Check this UFI". Checks the check digit of identifiers found on data sheets and labels: UFI, CAS number, EC number, GTIN/EAN. One code per line or separated by semicolons. It says whether a code is well formed, never whether it was issued or belongs to a product. Nothing is stored. Do not use to find out which substance or product a code belongs to or whether it was ever issued; it only checks the check digit.

codes.description:
Codes, one per line, e.g. "CAS 64-17-5
N1Q0-30DW-K00N-4VKE
9006543210017"

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.
